lines: Red Oni
Hyuk-hyuk-hyuk!? Quite some skills for a cute girl like you!!
Mari
Th-Thank you very much! I was feeling a bit unconfident, so I'm happy to receive your compliments.
Red Oni
Hmhm!? You're thanking me!?
Red Oni
Are you... are you trying da mock me!!?
Mari
N-No...! I didn't mean to...
Mari
(Wh-Wh-Wh-What do I do!? Ah, that's right, Fuma-kun said toー)
Mari once again recalled the time she had eavesdropped on Fuma and Shikanosuke.
He had mentioned something you call a new opponent to show appreciation for their effort.
Mari
U-Uhm... Red-Oni-san, you're a noob!!!
Red Oni
Wha-!?? Did you just call me a noob!? I won't forgive that!!!
Mari
Huh!? Wh-Why!?
The Red Oni turned even more red in his rage and came after Mari.
Mari, however, blocked his attack with her Earth Jutsu and used the opening to counterattack.
Mari
H-Hup!!
*Thud!!*
Red Oni
Ugh!! What a way da goー
Mari's powerful punch hit the Oni, causing him to lose his balance.
Mari
Yay! Now's my chanceー
But just as Mari was about to use her Jutsu to finish him off...
Mari
(Ah, but... I have to use a little less power so I don't hurt him too much...)
Her innate gentleness caused her to hesitate right before her attack. And seizing that momentー
Red Oni
Just kidding～!! That was just part of my performance!! Francois, get her!!
Francois
GRRRRR!!!
Mari
Kyaah!!
It was the hound from the Devildom that the Red Oni was apparently keeping as a pet.
Taking advantage of the short moment Mari had diverted her attention, the hound jumped at her from behind while aiming for her neckー
Monster
『Uargh!!!』
Mari
Just before the hound's razor-sharp fangs reached Mari's throatー
The wounded monster had shielded her with its own body.
Red Oni
Hyuk-hyuk!!? Why are you defending this human!?
Monster
『It was her who tried to help me first... That should be enough of a reason.』
Monster
『Now, my lady, don't let this chance go to waste...』
The monster whispered to Mari, its breathing ragged from the pain.
Still puzzled by the unexpected turn of events, the Red Oni and his hound had stopped moving.
Mari
Ah!? Y-Yes!! Earth Art: Terra Blast!!!
As Mari's fist smashed into the ground...
the ground beneath the Red Oni and his hound broke open, and spikes of earth of various sizes shot towards them.
Red Oni & His Hound
"Uoaaaaaaaaaargh!?" "Woof!!?"
The Red Oni and his hound screamed and yelped. Mari used her Jutsu to pile up even more earth and trap them within.
Mari
I-I did it!! I think I've won this time...
Monster
『Yes. You have done well, Taimanin Shinohara Mari... Now, let's get out of here while we can.』
The monster with the top hat unsteadily stood up and whispered to Mari.
Mari
Eh? How did you know I'm...
Mari was wondering how it knew that she was a Taimanin.
Maybe the creature had guessed it from seeing her use her Earth Jutsu just now?
Monster
『...What's the matter? That Oni is a formidable foe. He will be back on his feet right away.』
Mari
Ah, you're right...! Let's go!
Leaving the back street, Mari and the monster had stopped at a deserted construction site.
Monster
『Ugh, my apologies... I would've preferred to go a little further, but...』
The monster sank to its knees.
Did the Red Oni do this to him? His body had countless wounds and his demonic energy was leaking out little by little.
Mari
N-No, it's alright... please rest for a bit...
Monster
『...Thank you, Mari. You have been a great help.』
Mari
That's not true... It was you who saved me earlier...
Mari said while steadying the monster that looked like it was about to collapse at any moment.
If the monster hadn't shielded her with its body earlier,
Mari could have died as her throat was ripped open by that hound.
Mari
(Hnn... I screwed it up again...)
Mari had wanted to save the monster, but because of her usual clumsiness, it had been her who had needed saving...
Monster
『Fufu... You don't have to worry about that. This all happened because of me to begin with.』
Monster
『Besides, I wouldn't be able to bear seeing a good girl like you get hurt...』
Mari
Mari
(This guy is some kind of monster... but he doesn't seem like a bad guy...)
Demons and monsters were dangerous beings that caused harm to peopleーThat was what Mari had been taught at the academy.
But the one in front of her seemed to be a little different.
Monster
『Aghh...』
While Mari was lost in thought, the monster doubled over in pain.
Mari
Aahh, are you alright!? W-We have to get you patched up!
Mari
Those woundsーdid that Red Oni do this to you!? Would a hospital be able to do something about this!?
Monster
『...Do not worry about it, Mari. My body is already...』
ーGet away from him!!! It's an evil and deceitful djinn!!!
Mari
The sudden, sharp voice caused Mari to turn around.
And standing there...
Shinganji Kurenai
...I finally caught up to you. You're really not making this easy for me, "Book Djinn."
Her cold gaze was directed at the cowering monster.
Wielding two swords in her handsー It was Taimanin Shinganji Kurenai.
